name: Tatekawa Yuuma
source:
Protagonist in "Natsuoto."

A boy who moved from the city to town of Hakuri.
He was looking for a quiet place where he could be alone, but for one reason or another, everyone kept paying attention to him, and he couldn’t seem to be by himself.
Ended up feeling that wasn’t so bad after all, he had settled right in at Mijin-so.

There was someone he had to find.
It was his biological sister, from whom he had been separated one day…
